question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**complex**" means consisting of many different and connected parts. (जटिल)
 
• In the context of describing society, **"complex" **conveys that modern society has many diverse and interconnected aspects.
 
• The other options: "**fine**," "**systematic**," and "**easy**" do not capture the intricacy and interconnectedness described in the passage.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Hierarchy is key in ensuring normal functioning of our increasingly complex__ society.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fine (उत्तम)**: means very high quality or acceptable.
 
• **Systematic (सुनियोजित)**: means structured or methodical.
 
• **Easy (आसान)**: means not difficult or requiring little effort.
